name: Table
description: Native `<table>` semantics with the kit's chrome: render real table/thead/tbody/tr/th/td elements (useRender passthrough), so `scope`, screen-reader navigation and keyboard behaviour stay intact. A caller that wants a visually header-less table keeps its `<TableHead>` and hides it with `sr-only`; omitting the header would drop the semantics.

name: TableSortableHead
description: A column heading that sorts the rows (table.md, "Sorting"): a `TableHead` whose label is a `TableSortButton` filling the cell, with `aria-sort` on the cell and a 12px arrow on the sorted column only. Which column is sorted is the caller's: pass `sort` and update it from `onSortChange`. With `render={<div role="columnheader" />}` it draws a th-like cell, with the header type, line and padding, and sets no `scope`, which only a `th` takes. Native props, `className` and the ref go to the heading cell, not the button.

props.name: align
props.description: `"right"` for a right-aligned column, such as numbers: the label ends on the column's right edge and the arrow goes before it. Pass the same value to the column's cells.

props.name: firstSort
props.description: The direction of a first click, when the rows aren't sorted by this column: `"descending"` for numbers and dates, `"ascending"` for text.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called with the next direction: the reverse of `sort`, or `firstSort`.

props.name: sort
props.description: The column's current sort, or undefined when the rows aren't sorted by it. Sets `aria-sort` on the heading cell and draws the arrow.

name: TableSortButton
description: The button of a heading that sorts, on its own, for a header row drawn without `Table` (table.md, "Sorting"): the label, the 12px arrow on the sorted column (its room kept, empty, on the others), the label's color, the touch hit area and the sort cycle. It fills the heading cell around it, so the whole cell is the target. It has no padding and no border and inherits the font: the cell sets the type, height and line and has no padding, and the row's horizontal padding goes on the button through `className`. Set `aria-sort` on that cell, which needs `role="columnheader"` inside a `role="row"` in a `role="table"` or `role="grid"`; in development a warning says when there is no such cell or its `aria-sort` isn't `sort`. Native props, `className` and the ref go to the button.

props.name: align
props.description: `"right"` for a right-aligned column, such as numbers: the label ends on the column's right edge and the arrow goes before it.

props.name: firstSort
props.description: The direction of a first click, when the rows aren't sorted by this column: `"descending"` for numbers and dates, `"ascending"` for text.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called with the next direction: the reverse of `sort`, or `firstSort`.

props.name: sort
props.description: The column's current sort, or undefined when the rows aren't sorted by it. Draws the arrow and colors the label; set the same value as `aria-sort` on the heading cell around the button (in development, a warning says when they differ).
